description: This file contains implementation of common test functions for GstWebAudioPlayer, including setup and teardown procedures, mock expectations for pipeline creation, element linking, and sink initialization, used in unit testing of the GstWebAudioPlayer component.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeCreatedForLlama
methods.description: Prepares expectations for creating a GstWebAudioPlayer for Llama platform, including initializing source, threads, pipeline, app source, and AML halas sink.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeCreatedForXiOne
methods.description: Prepares expectations for creating a GstWebAudioPlayer for XiOne platform, including initializing source, threads, pipeline, app source, and RTK audio sink.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeCreatedForGenericPlatform
methods.description: Prepares expectations for creating a GstWebAudioPlayer for a generic platform, including initializing source, threads, pipeline, app source, and auto audio sink.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeDestroyed
methods.description: Sets up expectations for destroying the GstWebAudioPlayer, including resetting worker thread, stopping tasks, and terminating pipeline.

methods.name: expectResetWorkerThread
methods.description: Sets expectations for resetting the worker thread, including creating shutdown task and joining thread.

methods.name: expectTermPipeline
methods.description: Sets expectations for terminating the GStreamer pipeline, including bus retrieval and unref operations.

methods.name: expectTaskStop
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating and executing a stop task.

methods.name: executeTaskWhenEnqueued
methods.description: Mocks task enqueueing by executing the task immediately upon enqueue.

methods.name: expectInitRialtoSrc
methods.description: Sets expectations for initializing the Rialto source.

methods.name: expectInitThreads
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating worker and dispatcher threads.

methods.name: expectCreatePipeline
methods.description: Sets expectation for creating a GStreamer pipeline named 'webaudiopipeline5'.

methods.name: expectInitAppSrc
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating and configuring the appsrc element.

methods.name: expectAddElementsAmlhalaSink
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating and initializing AML halas sink elements.

methods.name: expectAddElementsRtkAudioSink
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating and initializing RTK audio sink elements.

methods.name: expectAddElementsAutoAudioSink
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating and initializing auto audio sink elements.

methods.name: expectMakeAmlhalaSink
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating AML halas sink element.

methods.name: expectInitAmlhalaSink
methods.description: Sets expectations for configuring AML halas sink element.

methods.name: expectMakeRtkAudioSink
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating RTK audio sink element.

methods.name: expectInitRtkAudioSink
methods.description: Sets expectations for configuring RTK audio sink element.

methods.name: expectMakeAutoAudioSink
methods.description: Sets expectations for creating auto audio sink element.

methods.name: expectInitAutoAudioSink
methods.description: Sets expectations for configuring auto audio sink element.

methods.name: expectLinkElements
methods.description: Sets expectations for linking pipeline elements including conversion, resampling, and sink.

methods.name: expectAddBinFailure
methods.description: Sets expectations for failure during adding bin elements to the pipeline.

methods.name: expectLinkElementFailure
methods.description: Sets expectations for failure during linking pipeline elements.
